name: Contacts
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: A keyboard-driven address book: a vdir store of vCards with a curses editor for every property, and a CardDAV client that syncs a Nextcloud address book. Themed from the applied Omarchy palette.

features: Keyboard editor (curses) for every property of a contact, standard or X-
vdir-style local store: one .vcf per contact, the layout vdirsyncer/Nextcloud use
CardDAV client: pull from and push to a Nextcloud address book
Import/export vCard files; search by name, email, phone or org
Follows the applied Omarchy theme palette, no hardcoded colours
Hyprland keybinding to open the editor
